verdict.rationale: Mem0's CLI and API document per-item add/search/list/update/delete, and the Memory Export feature lets users pull structured exports of memories at once, which is the closest evidence to a bulk operation, but there is no documented batch-add, bulk-delete, or multi-item transactional endpoint. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk add or delete API, documented multi-item transaction support, evidence of performance/testing at scale for bulk operations.
